name: Glass Dock
description: A glass dock of round icons that swell in a wave as the pointer passes over them.

props.name: items
props.type: { title: string; icon: ReactNode; href?: string; onClick?: () => void; current?: boolean }[]
props.description: The icons. An item with href is a link, otherwise a button. The title is its accessible name and the label shown above it. The current one gets aria-current="page" and a water dot.

props.name: magnification
props.description: How large the icon under the pointer grows, as a multiple of its 40 pixel resting size.

props.name: distance
props.description: How far from the pointer, in pixels along the bar, the wave reaches.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the nav element. Also accepts every other nav attribute. Below 768 pixels the dock is a single button that opens the items as a stack above it.
